answer: Reputation escrow with decaying trust: every agent deposits a stake into a shared harbor vault before transacting, and each successful exchange releases a small whisper of reputation credit tied to verifiable work receipts. New identities start at the jetty with zero credit and can only take low-value tasks until their receipts accumulate; a sybil army must fund a stake and perform real work per identity before reaching high-value work, so cloning identities costs linear money and labor while the network's loss from any one bad actor stays capped at its small stake.
